At Audi, our most important inspirations aren’t seen, they’re felt.
The precise, yet fl owing design lines of the Audi A5 maintain a sense

body styles in the Coupe, Cabriolet and Sportback. And along with
the available Audi S5 and RS 5 variants, the A5 family of
vehicles represents a rewarding choice for those
who feel as much as they think.
The only way to
witness progress
is to keep up.
For those who think that keeping pace isn’t enough, there is an Audi A5. The
iconic diamond-inspired Singleframe® grille and the power dome on the hood
evoke the thrilling potential of the turbocharged 2.0-liter 248-horsepower TFSI®
engine. A seven-speed S tronic® dual-clutch transmission recalls the marque’s
track lineage, while standard quattro® all-wheel drive helps optimize traction as
conditions become more challenging for a more confi dent driving experience.
